problem:
Let $T:{R}^{n}\to {R}^{n}$ be a linear transformation whose standard matrix is $T.$ Which of the following statements are true?

- If $\text{Ker}(T)={⟨x,y,z⟩\,|\,x+y=0}$ then $\text{rank}(T)+1=n$
- If there exists a vector $v\notin \text{Im}(T),$ then $|T|\ne 0$
- If ${{v}_{1},{v}_{2}}$ is linearly independent and $T({v}_{1})=T({v}_{2})=0$ then $\text{nullity}(T)=1$

choices.value: None of the statements are true

activity_context.topic_title: The Rank-Nullity Theorem in Terms of Linear Transformations
